configurePresets.name: cpu
configurePresets.description: No GPU backend at all. Needs nothing but a C++17 compiler.

configurePresets.name: vulkan
configurePresets.description: Vulkan backend. Needs the Vulkan SDK (glslc) and the SPIRV-Headers CMake package.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: CUDA backend. Needs the CUDA toolkit (nvcc); the GPU architecture is probed from nvidia-smi.

configurePresets.name: cuda-static
configurePresets.description: CUDA backend with static ggml backends, so the binaries need no libggml*.so and look like the release archives. Needs the CUDA toolkit (nvcc); the GPU architecture is probed from nvidia-smi.

buildPresets.name: cuda-static
buildPresets.displayName: Build the self contained CUDA tree
